mods.name: Podcast Randomizer
mods.author: mxous
mods.description: Shuffles podcast locations within their original areas. Reloading re-rolls any podcasts you haven't collected yet.

mods.name: FpsToggleMod
mods.author: Elwilo3
mods.description: Switch FPS limits in-game with hotkeys (keyboard or controller), for speedrun tricks like topgrabs. H opens the menu.

mods.name: UnityExplorer
mods.author: sinai-dev
mods.description: In-game inspector for Unity objects, scenes and components. Useful for finding things to mod.

mods.name: PracticeMod
mods.author: FinnLop
mods.description: Speedrun practice: save checkpoints and teleport back, NoClip, and adjust time scale, player size and acceleration. Includes preset checkpoints for the main splits.

mods.name: TeleportTool
mods.author: REVNERV
mods.description: A simple menu for teleporting to important locations.

mods.name: Get To Multiplayer
mods.author: itslaymxd
mods.description: Online multiplayer over the internet, up to 100 players in one server.

mods.name: Player Health
mods.author: itslaymxd
mods.description: Brings back the game's scrapped health system.

mods.name: FpsToggleMod (Nexus)
mods.author: FinnLop
mods.description: Toggle FPS limits on the fly with customizable keyboard and controller hotkeys. The Nexus release of FpsToggleMod; install only one copy.

mods.name: Performance Mod
mods.author: itslaymxd
mods.description: Raises FPS for players and speedrunners.

mods.name: FullForwardMod
mods.author: FinnLop
mods.description: Challenge mode where you always move forward, with a configurable grab nerf (Off, Recharging or One-use). Settings on TAB, help on K.

mods.name: Jump To Work
mods.author: FinnLop
mods.description: Replaces normal movement with Jump King style charged jumps.

mods.name: Get To Work Custom Maps
mods.author: itslaymxd
mods.description: Loads custom .g2wmap maps made with the Get To Work Map Tools.

mods.name: Get To Chaos
mods.author: itslaymxd
mods.description: Chaos mod: a random effect every 30 seconds. Supports user-made effects.

mods.name: Get To ReWorked
mods.author: Gorvert
mods.description: Multiplayer over Steam Networking for The Corporate Ladder, Doinkler Portfolio and Doinkler Special.
